frontMatter.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont
frontMatter.summary: Two home matches at Claremont—Navan 'A' vs Kildalkey (Grade 2 Mixed) and Navan vs Drumree (Grade 7 Mens) — plus member courts from 9pm and Juvenile Club Night from 6:30pm.

prev.title: Busy Week: 10 Matches, Big League Wins & 3 Cup Victories
prev.summary: A huge week with 10 matches played: standout league wins across Mixed and Ladies teams, two hard-fought Grade 2 Mixed draws, and three dramatic cup victories including two 7–5 thrillers. Another 11 matches await next week.

next.title: Wednesday Club Night
next.summary: Celebrate National Hugging Day at Wednesday Club Night—Grade 2 Ladies cup match (Navan 'A' v Ardee), two courts free from 8pm, and league-only action for juveniles.
